journey.name: Tablet player and learning tools v1.0.2
journey.description: Use the local demo workspace to verify browsing, dedicated playback, learning tools, immersive fullscreen and return navigation without touching a real account.

actions.action: Open Library and select the Build Better Habits with Systems episode
Verify the player has no Today dashboard or browsing sidebar and shows Summary Notes Quirky
Open Notes and verify the editable notes field is visible
Open Quirky and verify the question field is visible
Hide learning tools and verify the panel disappears
Enter full screen and verify the exit control and absence of episode actions
Press Back and verify fullscreen exits to the player
Show learning tools and open Summary
Return to Library and open Progress without a crash
